resources.name: INARA
resources.summary: Commander profiles, engineering data, markets, stations, outfitting, minor factions, community activity and other broad Elite Dangerous reference tools.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it as a general-purpose lookup for engineering, stations, markets, factions, outfitting and Commander information.

resources.name: EDSY
resources.summary: Detailed ship builder for modelling modules, engineering, power priorities, thermals, jump range and defensive performance.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it before spending credits or materials when you want to understand how a complete engineered build will behave.

resources.name: Spansh
resources.summary: Galaxy routing and search tools for neutron travel, exploration, fleet carriers and specialist long-range planning.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it when the in-game route planner is not enough, especially for neutron routes, carrier movement and galaxy-scale searches.

resources.name: Elite Dangerous
resources.summary: Frontier's official Elite Dangerous website for official game information, updates and announcements.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it when you need first-party information about the game rather than community interpretation.

resources.name: EDDiscovery
resources.summary: A broad journal companion that tracks travel history, materials, commodities, missions, expeditions, combat and other Commander activity.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it when you want a deep personal log of what your Commander has done and a powerful desktop view of journal-driven game data.

resources.name: EDCoPilot
resources.summary: Virtual cockpit assistant with searchable game information, navigation help, spoken assistance and an additional cockpit-style interface.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it when you want information and navigation help surfaced during play without constantly leaving the cockpit for external searches.

resources.name: SRVSurvey
resources.summary: Surface-focused companion for planetary survey work, exobiology, navigation, settlement activity and Colonization support.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it for serious surface work, especially exobiology and Colonization where journal-aware overlays and tracking save time.

resources.name: Raven Colonial
resources.summary: Colonization planning and logistics tool for construction progress, shopping lists, carrier staging, teamwork and system planning.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it to plan colony systems and keep multi-build hauling, construction requirements and carrier staging organized.

resources.name: Elite Dangerous Market Connector
resources.summary: Journal and Companion API utility that shares game data with community services and supports a large plugin ecosystem.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it when you want a lightweight data connector or need an EDMC plugin for a specific community tool or workflow.

resources.name: EDSM
resources.summary: Elite Dangerous Star Map database for systems, stations, celestial bodies, minor factions, travel history and exploration data.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it for galaxy and system lookups, exploration history and detailed information about systems, bodies and stations.

resources.name: Miner's Tool
resources.summary: Mining-focused lookup for known mining locations and current sell opportunities for valuable mined commodities.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it when you need an external mining location or want to find a strong current market for what you mined.

resources.name: Anti-Xeno Initiative Wiki
resources.summary: Specialist Anti-Xeno knowledge base with Thargoid mechanics, combat guides, ship builds and advanced AX technique.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it when you need dedicated AX doctrine or deeper Thargoid combat information than a general Elite reference can provide.

resources.name: Canonn Research Group
resources.summary: Community research hub focused on exploration, mysteries, Guardian and Thargoid discoveries, unusual phenomena and scientific investigation.
resources.mongrelUse: Use it when the question is about discoveries, alien or Guardian research, unusual galaxy phenomena, or the deeper investigative side of Elite.
